comparison.objective: Reconnect a sink stopper's eye to its pivot rod and seat the pivot ball.
comparison.physical_skill: Blind/constrained rod-to-eye alignment, insertion, and mechanism seating.
comparison.success_condition: External measurements and movement test confirm engagement, stopper remains centered/upright, parts released and still.
comparison.reason: Constrained linkage assembly and functional engagement do not test bulk separation through apertures.
